summary: ansible-core normally removes deprecated features in the fourth feature release after deprecation (deprecated in 2.10, removed in 2.13), though cycles can vary and unintended functionality can be removed without notice.
questions: How many releases before a deprecated ansible-core feature is removed?
If something was deprecated in ansible-core 2.10, when is it removed?
Can undocumented behavior be removed without a deprecation warning?

answer_card.title: ansible-core deprecation cycle
answer_card.answer_md:
Deprecations normally span **4 feature releases**; removal happens in the 4th release after the announcement. Example: deprecated in 2.10, removed in 2.13. The count is by number of releases, not version numbers.

Cycles may be longer or shorter depending on use or urgency, and unintended or undocumented functionality can be removed without any deprecation cycle.
